unit: One explicitly consented cat per CSV row; available from the first cat, no minimum group size.
consent: public-cat-ccby-v1. Earlier aggregate-only consent is excluded.
verification: Append &proof=1 for a separate, explicitly labeled verification dataset. It never appears in the real dataset.
method: X/Y is the mean of answered question coordinates weighted by A/B/C shares, with unchanged coordinates from the original 100-cat reference CSV. The nearest reference cat uses Euclidean distance and lowest cat number to break ties. All skipped uses (5,5). No psychological scale or representative population claim.

fields.data_kind: responses for published cats, verification for the separate test CSV
fields.public_id: Random public UUID, separate from the private storage ID; stable on retry
fields.reference_cat_name: Name of the nearest reference cat
fields.y: Authored design Y coordinate, 0..10; not geographic latitude
fields.quadrant: grove, sun, moon, rose: authored scenes using the center (5,5)
fields.q1_a..q5_c: A/B/C answer shares for each question, 0..1, sum 1 per answered question. All three empty for a skipped question. These shares reproduce the answer-driven cat appearance in the app.
fields.churu: 1 if small rewards or enjoyable invitations selected, otherwise 0
fields.license: CC-BY-4.0 for the consented cat data; artwork, reference data and cited works retain their separate terms
